jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_text:
Airbnb is seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to lead our Host Experience team.

About the role:
You'll own the product strategy and roadmap for features that help millions of hosts around the world manage their listings and provide great experiences for guests. This role requires strong analytical skills, user empathy, and the ability to drive consensus across engineering, design, and business stakeholders.

What you'll do:
- Define product vision and strategy for host-facing tools and workflows
- Lead cross-functional team of 10+ engineers and designers through full product lifecycle
- Conduct user research and data analysis to identify opportunities and validate solutions
- Write detailed PRDs and user stories with clear success metrics
- Manage product roadmap balancing business goals, user needs, and technical constraints
- Present product updates and recommendations to executive leadership
- Partner with data science team to analyze A/B test results and user behavior
- Collaborate with international teams across 15+ countries

Required qualifications:
- 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in consumer tech
- Track record of shipping successful products that drove meaningful business impact
- Strong analytical skills with experience using SQL, data visualization tools
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
- Experience leading cross-functional teams through ambiguous problems
- User-centric mindset with experience conducting user research
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, Design, or related field

Preferred qualifications:
- MBA or advanced degree
- Experience in marketplace or two-sided platform products
- Experience with internationalization and localization
- Technical background or ability to collaborate closely with engineers
- Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies

What we offer:
- Competitive compensation ($160K - $220K + equity)
- Annual Airbnb travel credit
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 401(k) matching
- Flexible work arrangements
- Professional development budget

Airbnb is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.jd_text:
Join Shopify as a Junior Software Engineer and help us empower entrepreneurs around the world!

About Shopify:
We're a leading commerce platform powering over 2 million businesses globally. Our mission is to make commerce better for everyone.

The role:
As a Junior Software Engineer, you'll work on our merchant-facing products, building features that help small businesses succeed online. You'll pair with senior engineers, ship code to production, and grow your skills in a supportive environment.

What you'll do:
- Write clean, maintainable code in Ruby on Rails and React
- Build new features for our merchant dashboard
- Fix bugs and improve application performance
- Participate in code reviews and learn from experienced developers
- Collaborate with designers and product managers
- Contribute to our engineering culture and documentation

Required:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent bootcamp experience
- 0-2 years professional experience (internships count!)
- Knowledge of at least one programming language (JavaScript, Python, Ruby, Java)
- Understanding of web development fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
- Familiarity with Git and version control
- Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn
- Good communication and teamwork abilities

Nice to have:
- Experience with React or other JavaScript frameworks
- Knowledge of Ruby on Rails
- Understanding of databases and SQL
- Personal projects or open source contributions
- Internship experience at a tech company

What we offer:
- Starting salary: $80K - $100K
- Comprehensive benefits (health, dental, vision)
- Stock options
- Learning and development budget ($1,000/year)
- Remote work setup budget
- Mentorship program
- Flexible work hours

Shopify celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.jd_text:
Stripe is looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our Payments Platform team.

About the role:
You'll work on building and scaling our core payments infrastructure that processes billions of dollars annually. This is a high-impact role where you'll design APIs, optimize performance, and ensure reliability for millions of businesses worldwide.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement scalable backend services using Ruby, Java, or Go
- Build RESTful and GraphQL APIs consumed by internal and external developers
- Optimize database queries and caching strategies for high-traffic applications
- Collaborate with product managers and designers to ship new features
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices
- Monitor production systems and respond to incidents as part of on-call rotation

Required qualifications:
- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong proficiency in at least one backend language (Ruby, Java, Go, Python)
- Experience designing and building RESTful APIs
- Solid understanding of databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB)
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
- Strong CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design)

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with microservices architecture
- Knowledge of Kubernetes and Docker
- Experience with payment systems or fintech
- Contributions to open source projects
- Familiarity with React or modern frontend frameworks

What we offer:
- Competitive salary ($140K - $200K based on experience)
- Equity compensation
- Comprehensive health benefits
- Flexible PTO
- Remote work options

Stripe is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.
